value.rationale: The natural n-cube is a canonical graph-state resource, and checkerboard entanglement is a central physical invariant. A family with an extensive 2^(n-2)-ebit baseline deficit attains absolute maximal bipartite entanglement by a provably minimum, explicit matching of missing CZ gates. Even more strongly, any partial subset gains one bit per omission. This is a structural extremal theorem for an infinite physically motivated network family, not merely routine finite enumeration or a rephrasing of its baseline.
